metadata.description: A marketplace of Claude Code skills for Tobrun's development workflows

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Development workflow skills: scope changes with argued decisions, build across unit/integration/e2e with every scenario proven by tests, ship with a deterministic quality gauntlet and an adversarially verified review, create structured commits that feed a decision ledger, and render pitches or comprehension quizzes.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: Software factory skills: factory-tuned scope, scope-review, build, and ship that read a per-attempt run file, resolve questions without a human, and write typed stage results, so the local factory runner can turn one interactively scoped change request into a ready pull request unattended.
